title.narrative: OUTPUT 1: Start Fund Nepal provides rapid, anticipatory and flexible response to crises

description.narrative: Decision-making and programming is member-led, collaborative, and informed by humanitarian and technical expertise and local knowledge. Responses are activated quickly, projects start rapidly, and beneficiary feedback mechanisms ensure accountability.

title.narrative: Number and percentage of crisis alerts (a) raised and (b) activated (proportion anticipatory alerts)

description.narrative: Tracks alert system performance. Annual Target: 29 alerts raised (12 anticipatory), 26 alerts activated (10 anticipatory). Activation rate: 89.66% overall, 83.33% for anticipatory. High activation demonstrates effective alert system and decision-making. Disaggregation between total and anticipatory alerts provided in comment narratives.

comment.narrative: Baseline: 24 alerts raised (10 anticipatory), 22 activated (9 anticipatory). Activation: 91.6% overall, 90% anticipatory
Q1 Cumulative: 26 raised (11 anticipatory), 24 activated (10 anticipatory). Rate: 92.3% overall, 90.90% anticipatory
Q2 Cumulative: 28 raised (12 anticipatory), 25 activated (10 anticipatory). Rate: 89.29% overall, 83.33% anticipatory
Q3 Cumulative: 29 raised (12 anticipatory), 26 activated (10 anticipatory). Rate: 89.66% overall, 83.33% anticipatory
Q4 Cumulative: 29 raised (12 anticipatory), 26 activated (10 anticipatory). Rate: 89.66% overall, 83.33% anticipatory

title.narrative: OUTCOME 1: Humanitarian action is timely, proactive, coordinated, and needs-driven

description.narrative: Humanitarian responses through Start Fund Nepal are delivered rapidly, meet actual needs of affected populations, incorporate beneficiary feedback, and reach people before crises peak through anticipatory action.

title.narrative: OUTCOME 3: LNNGOs have increased opportunities to access direct funding and influence decisions

description.narrative: Local and National NGOs receive increased direct funding, capacity building support, and partnership opportunities, leading to stronger local humanitarian leadership and more sustainable response capacity in Nepal.

title.narrative: Total amount and percentage of funding accessed by local/national NGOs (disaggregated by direct and indirect)

description.narrative: Tracks localization of funding. Direct funding: LNNGOs as primary recipients. Indirect funding: LNNGOs as sub-recipients through INGO partnerships. Target: Direct funding increases to 25% (£87,500), Indirect funding reaches 78% (£273,000). Disaggregation provided in comment narratives. This is an ANNUAL indicator reported once per year.

comment.narrative: Baseline Direct: £402,261.17 (13.41% of total). Baseline Indirect: £1,950,444 (75.10% of total). Currency: GBP

Annual Target: Direct £87,500 (25%), Indirect £273,000 (78%). Total LNNGO funding: £360,500. Disaggregation: Direct funding = LNNGO as primary recipient. Indirect funding = LNNGO as sub-recipient through INGO. Reported annually in March 2026.

title.narrative: IMPACT: Crisis-affected and at-risk populations' lives are saved, livelihoods protected, coping capacities increased and dignity maintained

description.narrative: The overall impact of Start Fund Nepal is to save lives and protect livelihoods of crisis-affected populations through rapid, flexible humanitarian responses that maintain human dignity and increase community resilience.

description.narrative: Total number of people directly receiving humanitarian assistance through Start Fund Nepal projects. Data disaggregated by: Age (<18 years, 18-50 years, >50 years), Sex (Male, Female), and Disability status (Persons with Disabilities).
